name: Isora Matsuri
source:
A second-year student at a private high school and one of [url=/c70330]Kouko's[/url] friends. A bright and innocent girl, Matsuri is popular with both boys and girls at her school and used to be a full-time member of the basketball club before her boyfriend from an university started working.

After her boyfriend started amassing debts, at his suggestion Matsuri started selling her body to pay them off...
